svg.title: Positive predictions: TN, FN, FP and TP regions
svg.desc: All customers form an ellipse split by two lines. The solid prediction line separates predict no churn (dashed, not interesting) from predict churn (solid slice). A dashed green line continues the actual-label boundary, giving four regions: TN, FN, FP and TP. The predict churn slice, FP plus TP, is the interesting part.
